routes.name: Registration of an EU citizen’s right of residence

note: Finland, read on Enter Finland (the Finnish Immigration Service's own application service, enterfinland.fi) on 2026-10-30; the Service's information site (migri.fi), the Ministry of the Interior's (intermin.fi) and Finlex's text of the Aliens Act (scripted) answered with a bot check or no text, so fees, decision times, terms and the years to permanent residence or naturalisation aren't read and aren't kept. A self-employed performer (a private trader with an individually owned business, or a partner in a general or limited partnership) applies for a residence permit for an entrepreneur, which asks sufficient financial resources in Finland; one abroad proves their identity at a mission (either). Citizens of the EU, Liechtenstein and Switzerland residing over 3 months register their right of residence with the Service, proving their identity in Finland within 3 months of arriving; Nordic citizens register with the Digital and Population Data Services Agency instead (the EEA's Iceland and Norway among them). A permanent residence permit (P) or a long-term resident's EU permit is applied for on Enter Finland. The residence permit for an employed person (which the work engine's route names) is on a page that lists application types only and isn't written.

sources.title: Enter Finland, Residence permit for an entrepreneur
sources.said: With this application you can apply for a residence permit for an entrepreneur. Granting a residence permit requires that you have sufficient financial resources in Finland. ... If you are abroad, you must prove your identity at a Finnish mission (embassy or consulate). ... If you are in Finland, you must prove your identity at a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service.

sources.title: Enter Finland, EU citizens and their family members
sources.said: You must apply for registration of your right of residence in Finland if you reside in Finland for over 3 months and are a citizen of an EU Member State, Liechtenstein or Switzerland. ... Visit a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service to prove your identity within 3 months of arriving in Finland. ... Nordic citizens (citizens of Denmark, Iceland, Norway or Sweden) must register their right of residence at the Digi

sources.title: Enter Finland, Permanent residence permits
sources.said: permanent residence permit (P) or a long-term resident’s EU residence permit (P-EU permit) for yourself or for a child who is under 18 years of age.
